The '''''Lady Akiko''''' was the personal [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] of [[Marshal/Legends|Marshal]] [[Levnis]], a planetary [[Baron/Legends|baron]]. For a long time, the ''Lady Akiko'' lacked a [[Kalld'n-class stardrive|''Kalld'n''-class stardrive]], forcing Levnis to turn to [[The Most Honourable Guild of Armourers]] to acquire the exceedingly rare device.
